lastResponse.text: I’m so sorry. That sounds serious, and it may be neglect. That may be neglect. First, safety first: if he is weak, confused, or breathing hard, call nine one one now. Call nine one one now. I can connect you to a live specialist to report the aide agency and get urgent backup care. One question: is he awake and speaking clearly right now?
